QuestInfo.name: Cold Milk
QuestInfo.1: To get the Unagi Special and some Fresh Milk, you need to gather some ingredients. Rina of Henesys wants #b50 Curse Eye Tails and 5 Pig's Heads#k for the Unagi Special. Rowen the Fairy in Ellinia wants #b5000 Mesos#k in exchange for Fresh Milk.
QuestInfo.2: Inside a tree tunnel near Ellinia, you find #bRonnie#k, Mr. Wetbottom's son. He says the red book is off limits, but he seems to be starving. In the end, you make a deal. If you get him #b20 Lupin Bananas, Rina's Unagi Special, and some Fresh Milk#k, he will hand over the book. According to Ronnie, you can find Rina in Henesys and the fresh milk from a fairy in Ellinia.

0.0: I'm sure you're aware that fairies aren't exactly friends with humans, so you must have a reason for bothering me. What do you want?
0.1: So you're here as a favor for #p1061004# to get some #b#t4031015##k? #p1061004# is the one boy that we have opened up to. Please hold on one second, and I'll get you the #t4031015#.
0.2: Then again... Hmm, I'm sure you know fairies love fancy, spectacular items, right? If you get me a refined #b#t4021007##k, I'll give you the #t4031015#.

yes.0: I can't give you milk for free, but I'd be happy to give it to you for #b5000 Mesos#k.

1.1: Please deliver this #b#t4031015##k to #p1061004#. I'll take good care of #t4021007# that you got me. I can't stop staring at it.

item.0: Give me #b5000 Mesos#k, and I'll give you the #t4031015#.
